# Rubis Switzerland Satin Tiffany Slanted Tweezer

## Precision Grooming for Every Hair Type

The slanted tip and sharp edges help you grip fine hairs and thick strands alike. Shape your brows or remove stubborn white facial hairs with controlled, precise results.

## Compact Enough for Home and Travel

The satin finish feels smooth in your hand, and the slim design fits easily into a makeup bag or carry-on. Keep one at your vanity and another in your travel kit so your grooming routine stays consistent wherever you go.

## A Polished Touch for Your Vanity

The signature Tiffany Blue finish adds a stylish accent to your daily routine. Rubis Switzerland has built a loyal following, and many repeat buyers say these are the tweezers they reach for again and again.

## Ready for Your Next Grooming Session?
